marta.ops: Canary rollout to cohort=prod-canary complete, starting smokewave (10m). Quick check: runbook -> https://redwood.local/runbooks/canary-smoke. @deploy-bot enable detailed probes (latency tails + kv/embeds) :rocket:
deploy-bot: Deploy note: release=2026.3.2, cohort=prod-canary (12 hosts), rollout=10%. Smokewave started, probe multiplier=3. Logs -> https://deploy.logs/3350012345
kevin.ml: Running model-variant health probes now. Noting GPU OOMs on node canary-5 around +2m. Extract from kube events:
```
Events from canary-5:
  Warning  OOMKilled  kubelet  container runtime OOMKilled process
  Normal   BackOff    kubelet  Back-off restarting failed container
```
sophia: Seeing embed route tail p99 spike to 2.2s (baseline p99 520ms). Also a small uptick in handle errors: "kernel-mismatch: quantized-ops-fallback" in logs.
oncall-sre: Confirmed OOMs coincide with model variant using new fused-kernel. Memory footprint +14% on canary-5 GPUs. Eviction/restarts triggered HPA jitter.
emily-pm: Any customer visible impact? Any errors hitting production routes?
kevin.ml: No broad customer reports. Fallback behavior: we have auto-fallback to variant=v2026.3.1q (older quantized build). Propose: 1) pause ramp, 2) pin canary cohort to fallback variant, 3) lower per-request batch size from 8->6 on canary-hosts, 4) increase synthetic sampling x5 for next 30m.
marta.ops: I'm pausing ramp at 10% now. @deploy-bot apply pin to cohort=prod-canary -> v2026.3.1q and set probe-rate=5x.
deploy-bot: Actions taken: ramp paused, variant pinned -> v2026.3.1q for cohort=prod-canary. probe multiplier updated. Incident channel #inc-33890 created.
oncall-sre: After pin+batch tweak p99 embed dropped to 540ms, OOM events stop. Memory below threshold. Still watching node canary-5 logs for kernel mismatch traces.
kevin.ml: Replayed 50 synthetic chatgen probes and embed tiny vectors: chatgen p95=320ms (baseline 300), embed p99=560ms. Acceptable delta.
sophia: Proposed rollback criteria if any of these occur: sustained p99 > 1s for 10m OR GPU OOM rate > 1 event/5m OR 5xx rate > 1% for 5m. Otherwise keep pinned and let ops produce a hotfix (remove fused-kernel or adjust memory allocation).
emily-pm: Good. I'll mark release notes: "hold on fused-kernel variant; canary pinned to q build; mitigations logged." Also notifying support.
marta.ops: Action items: ops to collect heapdumps and kernel trace from canary-5, kevin to test kernel-less build, sophia to keep probes every 2m and share charts. Reconvene T+20m for decision to resume or rollback fully.
oncall-sre: Opening short-lived incident runbook. If thresholds breach, we'll rollback entire release from prod stage.
kevin.ml: thumbs up. I'll upload test artifacts to https://artifacts.redwood/3350012345 and link here when ready.
marta.ops: Thanks all. Monitoring in progress. :eyes:
